subject: Acceptance path + Week0 canvas — template & initial draft
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ari Patel <ari.patel@neurolytics.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acceptance path + Week0 canvas — template & initial draft

Hi Ari — great to meet earlier on the call. As promised, I pulled together a lightweight acceptance-path template and a Week0 canvas so your team can validate the path to a quick technical decision.

What’s included in the pack: 1) Acceptance criteria matrix (success metrics & owner mapping), 2) Week0 cadence (stakeholder syncs + dev readiness checklist), 3) Risk/compatibility flags for privacy/compliance. I attached the .docx and .slides and also seeded the live copies below so we can iterate in place.

Proposed next steps:
- You: flag primary stakeholders (product/eng/security) and pick a 60–90 minute kickoff window (suggest week of Dec 6)
- Us: tailor the technical checklist to your infra (we’ll ask for the integration endpoints and expected throughput)
- Kickoff output: final Week0 acceptance milestones and a demo slot for the pilot env

Live drafts: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AqX-acceptance-path-draft (acceptance template)
https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1BqY-week0-canvas (Week0 canvas)

Attachments: acceptance_template_v1.docx, week0_canvas_v1.slides

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0191

---
Note: the doc contains a short table where we ask for target QPS and sample dataset size. If Ari can provide a ballpark that will help our runtime recommendations for the pilot.

We’re available for a kickoff on Tue Dec 8 or Wed Dec 9 afternoon EST. I’ve looped the program team on ops@neurolytics.ai who will coordinate stakeholders.

—Ari
